claim: For gfx1100 Q4-T16 down projection (K,N)=(17408,5120), the exact row64 shared-B sibling replaces the 256-row parent at rows 33-192. Counterbalanced clean sweeps are positive in both arm orders at every admitted point (1.009x-1.855x), while row 193 crosses sharply to 0.897x and remains a loss through row 257. A same-build full-category C1-C3 server pair is exact and improves C1 prompt throughput by 4.63%/4.51% in both K0 arms; the stable full-group control improves C2 by 0.62% and is flat-positive at C3 (+0.013%).

change.mechanism: The parent and sibling share the same four-wave, 48-column shared-weight block and the same K16 WMMA/F32-accumulator/BF16-store sequence. The sibling changes ROW_TILES_PER_WAVE from four to one, reducing ownership from 256 to 64 rows without changing arithmetic.
change.boundary: Row 193 requires a fourth 64-row group and is slower than the one-group 256-row parent; row 193 and later retain the parent.
change.fallback: The 256-row shared-B parent remains separately registered. HIPENGINE_GGUF_Q4_T16_SHARED_B_ROW64_MAX_ROWS=0 restores it on the same build for bisection; the knob cannot widen beyond the qualified range.

leaf_protocol.payload: repack_gguf_q4_k_tile16 output over a valid Q4_K block image
leaf_protocol.timing: wall around one launch plus device_synchronize; median over five forward/reverse order pairs and 50 reps/pass; no best-of selection
leaf_protocol.correctness: worst BF16 ULP distance versus the strict 256-row shared-B parent; every successful output must be finite
leaf_protocol.ratio_definition: shared_b_ms / shared_b_row64_ms, so greater than 1.0 favors row64

occupancy_and_trace.reading: The parent grid supplies only about 1.1 blocks/CU on 96 CUs, while 24 KiB LDS permits at most two blocks/CU. Row64 removes padded WMMA work and, above 64 rows, doubles supplied blocks/waves without a reduction or accumulation kernel. Split-K was not attempted because the reduction-free candidate already won and preserves exact ownership.

server_pair.protocol: Full mtp-bench code/general_en/general_ja/mixed_ja_en suite, 10 prompts at C1-C3, interleaved explicit-AR and automatic omitted-request K0 arms, one output token, production profile, resident capacity 8, complete blocking barrier-to-last-response wall, actual native-group capture.
server_pair.reading: C1 is the binding complete-server win: both exact arms and every category improve by at least 3.68%. The automatic omitted-request K0 arm is the stable C2/C3 full-group control and remains non-regressive. Explicit AR is reported but not used for the C2/C3 kernel verdict because its actual group mix changed from 0 to 2 full C2 groups and from 1 to 3 full C3 groups; task #29 owns that admission race.

gates.red_green: Selector RED failed on the absent owner/range, then GREEN pins rows 33-192 to row64, row 193 and misses to the parent, and max=0 rollback to the parent.
gates.parent_and_cpu_reference: Rows 35/48/67/192 pass byte equality against the strict parent and the existing Q4_K CPU-reference tolerance.
gates.focused_tests: timeout 300 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_gguf_q4_k_t16_dense.py -k 'routes_physical_r6 or shared_b_row64' -> 5 passed
gates.trace: Expected row64 kernel name observed with plausible resources/durations and exact SQ_WAVES 428/856 at rows 35/67.
gates.server: Both same-build packets complete, all within-packet exactness gates pass, 120 cross-packet generated rows match, and both release all tracked allocations.

limitations: The server pair has one packet per arm because it is a route-binding check; leaf timing uses five counterbalanced pairs and is the speed-boundary source.
The server automatic omitted-request arm declines MTP and executes K0/default. It is a causal full-group control, not a replacement for the canonical published AR scoreboard row.
C3 complete wall is flat within noise even though admitted leaf points are exact counterbalanced winners; the route is retained as a measured leaf/sub-window win under the project policy.
One unrelated untracked pre-existing grouping probe was present. Tracked source was clean and the probe was neither imported nor executed.
consequence_for_objective: Task #11 is complete. The exact default removes the diagnosed row-padding/low-wave-supply cost without introducing split-K, improves complete C1 prefill, and is non-regressive in the stable C2/C3 full-group control. Remaining broad server gaps belong to admission coalescing (#29) and the physical group-of-four/serial dependency path (#30), not this down-projection leaf.
